candidate_text: Be aware that once this locked door has broken, the broken door will remain standing open from now on, because its protection against pursuers was only ever meant to be temporary in the first place. Since the door is now broken, it cannot be relocked by you or anyone else under any circumstances. This means that any surviving enemies who were previously delayed by the locked door can, and will, continue their pursuit of you directly through the newly created breach in the doorway.
